identifiedRisks.description: Extreme technical complexity involving unproven technologies like the large-scale rotating centrifuge set, front projection systems, and zero-gravity rigs.
identifiedRisks.mitigation: Allocate significant budget for R&D, pre-visualization, and testing. Hire top-tier engineering and SFX teams.

identifiedRisks.description: Groundbreaking and extensive VFX requirements (205+ shots), including the abstract Stargate sequence, with high potential for schedule and budget overruns.
identifiedRisks.mitigation: Engage VFX supervisor from early prep. Budget for extensive motion control photography and optical printing. Build in contingency for VFX.

identifiedRisks.description: Requirement for numerous, large, and highly detailed sets (Discovery Centrifuge, Space Station, Moon Base) which are costly and time-consuming to build.
identifiedRisks.mitigation: Secure large-scale studio space well in advance. Detailed construction plans and budget must be locked early.

identifiedRisks.description: High-risk production elements including work with a trained lion, numerous other animals, and child actors, all of which have significant safety, logistical, and regulatory implications.
identifiedRisks.mitigation: Hire experienced animal wranglers and safety coordinators. Adhere strictly to child labor laws. Increase insurance coverage.

identifiedRisks.description: A long and complex production schedule (145 shooting days) with many dependencies between departments (e.g., SFX, VFX, stunts) increases the likelihood of cascading delays.
identifiedRisks.mitigation: Utilize advanced scheduling software. Build in contingency days for complex sequences. Ensure clear communication between department heads.
